workflowLanding.faqQ1: How does the direct email extraction work without hallucinating?
workflowLanding.faqA1: Our workflow enforces a strict two-part rule: an email address is populated only if (1) it literally appears inside the LinkedIn post text, and (2) the author explicitly designates it as the application channel. If no email is stated in the post, the system notifies you cleanly instead of guessing an address that bounces.
workflowLanding.faqQ2: How long does a full 3-layer inspection take?
workflowLanding.faqA2: Because JobPost X-Ray performs live multi-stage extraction across the LinkedIn post, the author's profile, and the company's official page before synthesizing the report, a typical scan completes in moments (usually under a minute, or slightly longer if a link requires deep company resolution). Both the Web Dashboard and Telegram Bot display live step-by-step progress updates.
workflowLanding.faqQ3: How does the Community & Curator format help Telegram or Slack admins?
workflowLanding.faqA3: Instead of manually reading unstructured LinkedIn posts and re-typing job summaries for your members, you simply send the link to JobPost X-Ray. You get a clean, verified Arabic or English summary with role requirements, company size, geographic presence, and direct application instructions ready to publish to your channel in one click.
workflowLanding.faqQ4: Is my Google Drive and Gmail account safe?
workflowLanding.faqA4: Yes. We only request permission to fetch your designated CV file and the restricted gmail.compose scope to create a draft inside your Gmail Drafts folder. Nothing is ever sent automatically without your review.
